title: FormField
description: Owns one input's label, description, error message, and required/invalid/disabled state.

details.when: Wrap exactly one Input, Textarea, Select, or similar control. Do not put several independent inputs in one FormField.

props.label: 表示名
props.error: 表示名を入力してください
表示名を入力してください

details.content: label is a noun phrase; description explains the effect; error says how to fix the value.

behavior.ids: Generates stable ids and connects the child control through aria-describedby (help, then error).
behavior.invalid: Passing error sets aria-invalid on the child control and renders the message next to it.
behavior.ownership: The consumer owns name, validation, and submission.
